scope: local finite-suite release eligibility; not production certification
holdout_protocol: Original six development cases and the twelve now-known first holdouts remain unchanged as regression. These six additional cases are frozen before bounded-reasoning evaluation and are not used to tune prompts, expected outcomes or budgets. Same engineer authored known domain rules and cases; not a blind external benchmark. Exactly one reference/candidate comparison; preserve any failure and do not search budgets until it passes.
